symbol.note: Root symbol RP2350B used for the RP2354B (identical pinout per 14.3 p.1327). Symbol names differ from the datasheet only in notation: 'GPIOn/ADCm' vs 'GPIOn_ADCm', '~{QSPI_SS}' vs 'QSPI_SS'.

errata.applies: Only on A2 stepping (fixed in A3, Appendix C.2.1 p.1349). Stepping of the RP2354B parts JLC/LCSC C39843328 supplies: unknown.
errata.why: Bank 0 pad with IE set and output off sits near 2.2 V unless pulled low through <= 8.2 kOhm; internal pull-down can't overcome it. Design already uses 4.7k on PWR_HOLD (GPIO2, R42) and CHG_OFF (GPIO19, R44). AMP_EN (GPIO11, R37 100k) and BL_PWM (GPIO44, R60 + R61 103.9k) rely on > 8.2k pull-downs: safe while the pins are outputs or at reset (IE clear at reset), but not if firmware releases them as inputs with IE set. ADC pins (GPIO45-47): clear IE as the workaround says. Button and REV inputs use pull-ups, which E9 doesn't affect. SWD pads are pull-up and unaffected.
Disruption of USB_OTP_VDD (pin 68) can corrupt OTP reads. Relevant because design.py accepts +3V3 dips toward 2.97 V on USB unplug with a low cell, below USB_OTP_VDD's 3.135 V minimum.

errata.applies: A2, A3, A4 (mitigated in A3 for the bootrom).
errata.why: Firmware using the USB device must run clk_sys >= 1.1x clk_usb. Firmware issue, no pin impact.
UF2 drag-and-drop with partition tables; matters only if the board ships A2 and uses partition tables (programming via BOOTSEL/QSPI_SS). No pin impact.
Bootrom CS1 pin handling. No external QSPI CS1 in this design: does not apply.

errata.applies: No: QFN-60 only; U4 is QFN-80.

errata.why: No effect on any package pin connection.

pins.requirement: Core supply 1.05-1.16 V typ 1.1 (Table 1688 p.1341). 'Must be connected externally, either to the voltage regulator output, or an external board-level power supply' (Table 2 p.17). With the on-chip regulator: the two DVDD pins closest to the regulator get 100 nF each, the one furthest gets 4.7 uF (6.1.3 p.400).
pins.quote: the two DVDD pins closest to the regulator should be decoupled with a 100nF capacitor close to the pins. The DVDD pin furthest from the regulator should be decoupled with a 4.7μF capacitor close to the pin.
pins.issue: OPEN QUESTION (decoupling, not the net): +1V1 in design.py has C20-C22 3x100n plus one 4.7u (C25, the regulator's COUT on VREG_LX's wide pads). 6.1.3 and Figure 22 show a 4.7 uF on the DVDD pin furthest from the regulator in addition to COUT (6.3.8.1 p.412: 'In addition to COUT ... we recommend a second 4.7μF capacitor ... on the VOUT net'). design.py has no second 4.7 uF on +1V1. Which DVDD pin is furthest is a layout fact (pin 10, on the edge opposite the VREG pins 61-65, is the likely one); unknown from design.py.

pins.issue: NOTE: R23 10k pull-up to +3V3 plus R25 1k + SW18 to GND. Pressed: about 0.3 V, a valid low. The datasheet suggests 4.7k so the chip's own CS drive isn't loaded; 1k loads it at about 3.3 mA while the button is held. Works, but not the datasheet's suggested value.

pins.requirement: IO supply, 1.62-3.63 V (typ 1.8/3.3 V) (Table 1688 p.1340); all 8 IOVDD pins are one supply (Table 1679 p.1334). VOLTAGE_SELECT default 0 is valid for 2.5-3.3 V (6.1.1 p.400).

pins.requirement: Bank 0 GPIO, IOVDD domain; reset: pull-down, input buffer disabled, isolation latched (9.3). FT: tolerates up to 5.5 V with IOVDD=3.3 V, <=3.63 V with IOVDD=0 (Table 1680 p.1335). Unused here: no datasheet requirement to tie off (reset state is pulled low).
